description.text: The second expansion of the LEGEND series, released on 11 February 2010. The legendary Entei, Raikou and Suicune return as LEGEND cards in pairs: Entei & Raikou, Raikou & Suicune and Suicune & Entei, each with two types and two Weaknesses, and giving the opponent two Prize cards when Knocked Out. Its Great Pokémon include Kingdra, Lanturn, Tyranitar and Steelix, and it brought the first Darkness and Metal Pokémon of the LEGEND series. The cards are numbered to 80, with another hidden Alph Lithograph as 081. In English its cards were split between HS—Unleashed in May 2010 and HS—Undaunted in August 2010.
